summary: community.vmware deprecates module_utils.vmware connect_to_api and the vmware_guest_powerstate module, which will be removed in 7.0.0.
questions: Should custom modules still use connect_to_api from community.vmware?

answer_card.title: vmware_guest_powerstate deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
- `vmware_guest_powerstate` is deprecated and will be removed in community.vmware 7.0.0.
- `module_utils.vmware.connect_to_api` is deprecated.
